subject: SIG questionnaire + evidence sprint for Luminex integration
messages:
From: Carmen Tran <carmen.tran@luminexbio.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@luminexbio.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire + evidence sprint for Luminex integration

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the product looked promising. Procurement and InfoSec here at Luminex have started our vendor assessment. Attached is our SIG workbook (v2026) and a short questionnaire that focuses on data residency, encryption key management, and privileged access.

Can Redwood confirm whether you can: 1) populate the SIG control responses and map to your SOC 2 / ISO evidence, 2) provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and ISO scope statement, and 3) run a focused "artifact sprint" with our collectors during the week of May 10? Our target is to complete the assurance packet by May 21 so procurement can review prior to the security review board on May 25.

A couple of quick clarifications that would help:
- Does Redwood support customer-managed KMS (HSM) for private deployments?
- Is there an attested list of data centers/regions in scope for ISO 27001?

Attached: Luminex_SIG_v2026.xlsx (please place your answers on the "Vendor Response" tab).

Regards,
Carmen Tran
Sr. Vendor Security Manager
Luminex Biomedical

---
Attachment: Luminex_SIG_v2026.xlsx (Excel workbook, 1 sheet stub)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Carmen Tran <carmen.tran@luminexbio.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence sprint for Luminex integration

Hi Carmen — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. We can run the artifact sprint and populate the SIG workbook, and I’ve proposed a short intake plan below.

High-level plan (proposed):
- Today (May 3): Confirm owners and scope; we’ll upload a shared folder with baseline artifacts (SOC2, ISO scope, control mappings).
- May 6: Redwood to pre-fill Vendor Response tab with control-level answers where possible (N/A, In Scope, Process Owner notes).
- May 10–12: Artifact sprint — our collectors (Neha and Karthik) will be on a daily 30-min sync with your collectors to walk through evidence drop-offs and clarify control mappings.
- May 14: Redwood deliverable — control crosswalk PDF + artifact index.
- May 21: Final assurance packet delivered to Luminex procurement.

Owners from Redwood:
- Neha Kapoor — Security evidence lead (neha_kapoor@redwood.ai)
- Karthik Iyer — Audit & control mapping (karthik_iyer@redwood.ai)
- Marissa Cole — Customer success / intake coordination (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Soojin Lee — Program owner and escalation contact (soojin_lee@redwood.ai)

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Customer-managed KMS (HSM): Supported in Redwood Private; we can provide integration guidance and key custody documentation.
- ISO 27001 scope: Our current ISO scope covers hosted API and dedicated clusters in us-west-2 and eu-west-1; we’ll attach the formal scope statement.

I’ve attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) PDF with milestones. If this looks good, can you confirm the collector list and availability for May 10–12?

Thanks — Soojin

--
Redwood Inference
Soojin Lee
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: Redwood-MAP-Luminex-20270503.pdf (1 page, stub)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Luminex SIG — evidence plan and gaps

Team — jotting down evidence items we can stage in the shared folder this week. I’ll own the artifact sprint sessions and Karthik will own control mapping logic (SOC2->SIG/ISO crosswalk). Marissa, please confirm CS availability for intake touches.

Planned deliverables to upload by EOD May 6:
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf (redacted) — includes control narratives and test results
- ISO27001-scope-statement.txt — includes control boundary and list of in-scope regions
- PrivilegedAccess-Runbook.pdf (redacted) — for SIG control CAATs that ask about administrative access
- KMS-Integration-Architecture.png — diagram showing customer-managed KMS option for Redwood Private
- Artifact index CSV (artifact_index_20270506.csv) — mapping filename -> control ids -> short description (we’ll export this later as PDF)

Open questions to flag in the workbook (I will mark these in the Vendor Response tab):
- SIG Control 6.2.1 (Data residency controls): Need clarification whether Luminex requires encryption-at-rest key separation between environments or tenant-level HSM for multi-tenant hosted API.
- SIG Control 9.3.4 (3rd-party backups): Are you requesting backup retention evidence for our managed hosted environments or only for Dedicated/Private contracts?

I’ll also start drafting a short binding statement for procurement about evidence handling and redaction policies (to avoid sending production PII).

- Neha

---
Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf (redacted stub), ISO27001-scope-statement.txt (stub), PrivilegedAccess-Runbook.pdf (stub), KMS-Integration-Architecture.png (stub)

From: Carmen Tran <carmen.tran@luminexbio.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Jared Price <jared.price@luminexbio.com>, procure@luminexbio.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence sprint for Luminex integration

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Data residency: We need confirmation that for our tenant (Luminex), data at rest will reside in us-west-2 only. If Redwood hosted API would replicate logs/indices to other regions for reliability, we need to know what is in scope.

2) Backups: Procurement only needs backup retention evidence for production data backing Luminex tenant; you can redact customer-identifying fields.

3) KMS: Luminex is considering private deployment for the initial rollout due to regulatory requirements. Can you outline typical onboarding timeline for Redwood Private (networking, HSM attestation)?

4) MSA / DocuSign: Procurement would like a placeholder MSA to start redlines in parallel. Can you send a DocuSign envelope or a link to a standard MSA?

Collectors confirmed: Jared Price (security), Priya R. (infrastructure), and Hannah L. (procurement) will join the sprint May 10–12 from 10:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks, Carmen

---

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Carmen Tran <carmen.tran@luminexbio.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence sprint for Luminex integration

Carmen — great, thanks for confirming collectors and the sprint window. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Residency: Redwood hosted API will keep tenant data in us-west-2 by default for your account; we will not replicate PII-containing indices outside the region for Luminex without written approval. I’ll attach a short residency statement to the shared folder.
- Backups: We will provide redacted backup retention metadata for production (retention window, encryption status, location).
- Redwood Private onboarding: Typical timeline is 6–8 weeks for a standard network + HSM onboarding (shorter if using our managed subnet templates). I’ll have Karthik pull a checklist for the network prerequisites and Neha will attach the HSM attestation template.
- MSA: Sending a DocuSign envelope now (placeholder) — Procure can start redlines. Envelope id: ABC123-LUMX-MSA (link in Drive).

I’ve created the shared Drive folder and uploaded the initial artifacts (SOC2, ISO scope, MAP). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-Luminex-SIG-shared. We’ll pre-fill the Vendor Response tab by EOD May 6 and be ready for the May 10 sessions.

If anything changes on your side, flag it here and we’ll adjust. Otherwise we’ll see the collectors next Monday at 10:00 PT.

Best,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee | Redwood Inference
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
